name: maison-pos
description: Offline desktop POS and inventory management for a clothing boutique
author: Vetora POS

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm --prefix renderer run start" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && cross-env MAISON_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
